_comment: Every photograph the site displays. `subject` is what the photo actually shows — it is reviewed against the contact sheet, and it drives both alt text and the credits page. `context` is where it appears. `width` is the largest size the slot ever renders at, so we never ship a 6,000px original into a thumbnail.
